summary: A local-owner payment already dispatched (bank return, 60 s timeout reconciliation, resume) no longer requires the one-shot acceptance gate that its own start consumed, so a SONEDE payment cancelled or approved at the bank reaches a terminal state; starting a new payment still requires the armed gate.
reason: S24 06/11 23:52, first live SONEDE payment by conversation: owner biometric accepted, Amine cancelled on the ClicToPay/3DS page; the app intercepted /api/newpaiement/rejectpay and requested the bank return at 23:53:56, but resumeFromBankReturn and timeoutBankAction both refused (local_owner_payment_contract_unverified: localOwnerValidated mirrors the consumed gate). The record stayed requires_bank_action and kept invoice 312854662 guarded; SONEDE readback 23:58: invoice still due, nothing collected. A successful payment would have stayed unconfirmed the same way.

tests.name: openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui/scripts/test-payment-gate-continuation.cjs
tests.evidence: Adapter whose localOwnerValidated mirrors a gate consumed by executeLocal (same as clicToPayLivePaymentAdapter localRequiresGate): bank return reaches resume and ends failed/cancelled; a confirmed result is applied; timeout reconciliation reads the invoice and closes cancelled; a new payment still requires the armed gate and the pending reference stays guarded; the bank return token stays single-use; never a second submission.

capabilities.reason: Same capability payment.owner_native (registry owned by samantha-ui-playbooks); this repairs the continuation of an already-started payment record.

architecture.reason: Existing payment core continuation paths; no new store, router, scheduler or daemon.

limitations: The SONEDE success return (/recu) is still unobserved live.
